_about: scripts/check-copy.cjs: every sentence a screen or component writes is .fig text (constants/figma-tokens.json texts) or listed here under the reason it is shown. Noise (internal behaviour, hedging, a fact said twice) has no reason: delete it at its source.

reasons.legal: A consent, sensitive-data, retention or AI-output notice the law asks for, said once where the action happens.
reasons.error: A failure, and what the user can do about it.
reasons.confirm: Asks before an action the user would not want by accident.
reasons.login: Why the screen needs sign-in, and what signing in unlocks.
reasons.loading: Says what the screen is waiting for.
reasons.empty: An empty state: why nothing is listed, and where to go instead.
reasons.done: Confirms what the user's action just did.
reasons.next_step: Tells the user what to do next.
reasons.fact: A fact the user needs to decide the next action: what an item or value is, when it changes, what a choice means.
reasons.option: A choice or button the user picks, in the user's own words.
reasons.faq: A question and answer on the 자주 묻는 질문 screen, which the user opened to read them.
reasons.matcher: Words the server matches in what the user typed (a request, a refusal); never drawn.
reasons.blocklist: A claim phrasing the answer validator rejects; never drawn.
reasons.prompt: Text sent to the model, or a probe of what users type at it; never drawn.
